test_title: RRB Technician Grade III 2025: Morning Practice Day 2
subject: general
question: Calculate the power (in W) of an engine if it can perform 120 J of work in 3 seconds.
solution:
__CONCEPT__:

Work done (W): When a force is applied on a body and there is a displacement of the body in the direction of force then the work is said to be done by the force.

 
• The SI unit of work is Joule.
 
• 1 Joule (J) = 1
